content.title: About
content.content: Frozen yogurt bar, chocolate is a frozen yogurt bar coated with a chocolate glaze. The combination of smooth yogurt and crunchy chocolate makes it a popular snack for both children and adults.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The yogurt base contains live probiotic cultures that support gut health.
The chocolate coating is often made from dark chocolate, increasing antioxidant content.
Frozen yogurt bars first appeared in the United States in the 1970s as a lighter alternative to ice cream.
Flavor is frequently enhanced with natural aromatics such as vanilla or berries.
Bars are packaged in individual wrappers, facilitating transport and storage.

items.title: Probiotics
items.content: Live cultures in the yogurt help maintain a healthy digestive microbiome.

items.title: Lower Fat Content
items.content: Compared with traditional ice cream, frozen yogurt bars usually contain less fat.

items.title: Calcium
items.content: Yogurt provides a good source of calcium for strong bones.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Yogurt supplies vitamin B12 and riboflavin, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Chocolate Antioxidants
items.content: Dark chocolate is rich in flavonoids that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Milk Protein Allergy
items.content: Yogurt contains lactose and casein, which can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sugar Content
items.content: Bars are often sweetened, so people monitoring sugar intake should consume them in moderation.

items.title: Thermal Shock
items.content: If the bar warms too quickly, the chocolate coating may crack, affecting texture.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Yogurt’s low pH can be irritating to sensitive teeth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the bar straight from the freezer, allowing the chocolate coating to soften slightly. It can also be sliced and added to fruit salads or smoothies.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store bars at –18 °C or lower in a sealed package. After removal from the freezer, consume within 30 minutes for optimal texture. Do not keep thawed bars for more than 2 hours.
